name: Legal Deadline Calculator
description: Count calendar or business days from a trigger date, skip weekends and federal holidays, and see the count on a calendar.

name: Post-Judgment Interest Calculator
description: Interest on a federal civil judgment under 28 U.S.C. 1961, computed daily and compounded annually, with a year-by-year chart.

name: Billable Hours Calculator
description: Convert minutes to billable hours with any increment, track an annual target, and model realization and collections.

name: Law Firm KPI Calculator
description: Utilization, realization, collection, margin, revenue per lawyer, and intake funnel metrics from your own totals.

name: Law Firm SEO ROI Calculator
description: Model SEO return from your own costs, fees, and intake rates, with low, base, and high scenarios, payback month, and break-even clients.

name: Legal Software Cost Calculator
description: Compare up to three legal software plans by monthly, first-year, and contract-length cost, with setup fees spread across every user.

name: Payment Processing Fee Calculator
description: See what card and eCheck payments cost your firm each month, your effective rate, and the saving if more clients pay by bank transfer.

name: eDiscovery Cost Calculator
description: Compare per-GB, per-user, and per-case tier pricing for one matter, with culling after early case assessment.

name: Contingency Fee Calculator
description: Break a settlement into attorney fee, case costs, liens, and the client's net, with costs taken out before or after the fee.

name: LSAT Score Calculator
description: Look up the percentile for any LSAT score from LSAC's 2023-2026 table, find the score for a target percentile, and convert a practice test raw score.

name: Wrongful Termination Settlement Calculator
description: Add up back pay, a front pay scenario, and damages, with federal caps by employer size applied.

name: Car Accident Settlement Calculator
description: Add up medical bills, lost wages, and property damage, test a pain and suffering figure, and see the net after fault, fees, and liens.

name: Probate Attorney Fee Calculator
description: Calculate the Florida probate attorney fee presumed reasonable from the estate's compensable value, with every bracket shown.

name: Impairment Rating Payout Calculator
description: Estimate Florida workers' compensation impairment income benefits from the average weekly wage and impairment rating, with each step shown.

name: Workers Comp Calculator
description: Estimate Florida workers' compensation temporary total and partial disability checks from the average weekly wage, with the waiting period and 104-week limit applied.

name: EEOC Settlement Calculator
task: Check an EEOC deadline and damages limit
description: Find your EEOC charge filing deadline and build a discrimination settlement scenario with back pay and the federal damages caps by employer size.

name: Law Firm Name Generator
description: Generate law firm name ideas from your surnames, practice area, and city, with each idea checked against bar rules on trade names and misleading names.

name: Law Firm Break-Even Calculator
description: Find how many billable hours a month your firm needs to cover overhead and owner pay, after realization and collection.

name: Demand Letter Generator
description: Draft a clear, factual demand letter for money owed, with a firm payment deadline and the next step you plan to take.

name: Dog Bite Settlement Calculator
description: Add up dog bite medical bills and other losses, test a pain and suffering figure, and apply Florida's dog owner liability rule.

name: Law School Debt Calculator
description: Estimate the balance, monthly payment, and total interest on law school loans, including interest that builds while you are in school.

name: Law Firm Client Acquisition Cost Calculator
description: Find your cost per lead and client acquisition cost, and plan the marketing budget for a target number of new clients.

name: NDA Generator
description: Draft a plain-English mutual or one-way NDA, with the federal whistleblower notice added when an employee or contractor signs.

name: Personal Injury Settlement Calculator
description: Add up medical bills, lost wages, and other losses, test a pain and suffering figure, and see the net after fault, fees, and liens, with a knee injury mode.

name: Law School Scholarship Calculator
description: Compare the net cost of two law school offers and stress-test a conditional scholarship you might lose after the first year.

name: Service Contract Generator
description: Draft a plain-English independent contractor services agreement with scope, fees, payment terms, termination, and ownership of work.

name: Wrongful Death Settlement Calculator
task: Value lost support in today's dollars
description: Turn years of lost family support into a present value and add the other damage types Florida law lists for wrongful death claims.
